title: The Dirichlet problem as the boundary of the Poisson problem: A sharp approximation result
summary: On a bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb R^{n+1}$, $n\geq2$, satisfying the corkscrew condition and with Ahlfors regular boundary, we characterize the dual space to the space ${\bf N}_{2,p}$ of functions $u$ whose Kenig-Pipher modified non-tangential maximal operator $\mathcal N_2(u)$ lies in $L^p(\partialΩ)$, $p\in(1,\infty)$.
